name: ModelVariant438_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant438_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the 0x44-byte command row indexed by the request, gets three slot parts and packs five texture images before setting up the swarm, band, sheet, ring, spoke, quad and web records, otherwise it runs one frame (the swarm from the config start frame) and returns 4 in phases 2-4, then 1 once and 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every image that builds the entry; the PAL images build it through french_model_variant/variant455_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and the PAL palette x (the PAL raw slot-1 images 117510/2674 build only the swarm helper); HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
